_description: Manual taxonomic corrections for the Ithomiini dataset. These corrections override GBIF Backbone Taxonomy results where the literature supports a different name. Researchers can review, edit, and extend this file.
_references: Lamas G (2004) Checklist: Part 4A, Hesperioidea - Papilionoidea
Willmott KR & Lamas G (2006) Revision of Hyalenna Forbes (Nymphalidae: Ithomiinae: Oleriina)
Willmott KR & Lamas G (2007) A revision of Pachacutia de Haas (Nymphalidae: Ithomiinae: Napeogenina)
Willmott KR et al. (2020, 2021) Tropical Lepidoptera Research
de-Silva DL et al. (2010) Molecular phylogenetics, Ithomiini
ICZN International Code of Zoological Nomenclature, 4th ed.
_how_to_contribute: To add a new correction, add an entry to the appropriate section below. Each entry includes the original name, the corrected form, and a literature reference justifying the change. Submit a pull request with your additions.

subspecies_corrections._description: Subspecies name corrections. Detected via frequency analysis (rare misspellings vs abundant correct forms within the same species) and verified against Butterflies of America, nymphalidae.net, and funet.fi. Cases 5 and 7 are notable: the MORE COMMON form in the dataset is actually the misspelling.

typos.reason: Letter transposition (gn -> ng). No subspecies 'angosia' exists.
Letter transposition (na -> ra). O. onega janarilla (Hewitson 1863) is the correct form.
Wrong Latin ending (-formes is for orders like Passeriformes; correct adjectival form is -formis). Note: this subspecies actually belongs to M. polymnia, not M. mazaeus.
Missing 'h'. From Greek xanthos (yellow). S. zibia xanthina (H. Bates 1866).
typos.reference: H. Bates 1866; Butterflies of America; BAMONA

typos.reason: IMPORTANT: the more common form (doryssides, 46 records) is the misspelling. Staudinger [1884] originally described it as 'dorissides'; 'doryssides' is a misspelling from Staudinger 1885. funet explicitly documents this.
typos.reference: Staudinger [1884]; funet (missp. note); Butterflies of America

typos.reason: Letter transposition (iy -> yi). M. ludovica paraiya Reakirt 1866.

IMPORTANT: the more common form (neseaea, 48 records) is the misspelling. The standard spelling across Butterflies of America, Wikispecies, and published papers is 'nesaea'. 'neseaea' is a database artifact from LepIndex/Catalogue of Life.
Erroneous 'n' inserted. C. hezia phagesia (Hewitson 1869) is the correct form.
typos.reference: Hewitson 1869; Butterflies of America (type specimen page)

typos.reason: c/z confusion. O. victorine graziella Haensch 1905.
Extra 's' inserted. Named after Eratosthenes of Cyrene.
Extra 'u' and 's'. Named after Eratosthenes of Cyrene.
y/i confusion. Named after Tomasz W. Pyrcz, Polish entomologist.

valid_species_not_in_gbif._description: Species confirmed valid in taxonomic literature but absent or misclassified in the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy. These receive status 'verified_literature' instead of 'higher_rank_only'. Grouped by reason for GBIF absence.

Hypomenitis.reason: GBIF wrongly synonymizes Hypomenitis Fox 1945 with Greta; Lamas (2004) treats Hypomenitis as valid separate genus in subtribe Godyridina

Ollantaya.reason: Resurrected from synonymy of Hyposcada by de-Silva et al. (2010) molecular phylogenetics; GBIF still lists as DOUBTFUL

Pachacutia.reason: Valid genus revised by Willmott & Lamas (2007); GBIF still lists as DOUBTFUL

individual_species._description: Species individually confirmed valid in specialist literature but missing from GBIF backbone. Most are recognized on nymphalidae.net and/or Butterflies of America.
